obligations.semantic_rule: The reference uses Grafana regexp v0.0.0-20240518133315-a468a5bfb3bc, NOT the Go go1.23.4 regexp parser and not the owned Go1.27.3 regexp parser. Pin Perl-mode RE2 syntax: alternation/concatenation, greedy/lazy repetition, named/numbered/noncapturing groups, scoped i/m/s/U flags, anchors and ASCII word boundaries. Backreferences, lookaround and possessive quantifiers are rejected. Counted repetition bounds above1000 and excessive nested repeats are parse errors; unlimited * and + are not capped by the counted-repeat syntax limit. New syntax in owned stdlib is not enabled implicitly.

Pinned Grafana syntax unicodeTable accepts exact case-sensitive keys from runtime unicode.Categories and unicode.Scripts, plus special Any. It does NOT consult unicode.Properties or CategoryAliases, normalize case/separators, or recognize Assigned/ASCII aliases. Therefore raw owned Go1.26/1.27 stdlib regex is not a compatible substitute even when unicode.Version happened to agree. Go1.23.4 lacks Cn and LC keys, so these property patterns are errors.

primitive_probes.expected: unknown property error despite stdlib alias support
unknown property error: Properties map not consulted

obligations.semantic_rule: Use the exact hashed go1.23.4 Unicode15 tables, not the version string alone and not Unicode17 tables. C excludes unassigned codepoints; Cn is not an accepted key. Relative to owned Unicode17, both references reject newer script names and retain older category membership. These table differences affect positive/negative character classes, regex acceptance and case-insensitive classes.

Case-insensitive matching uses the reference Unicode simple-fold equivalence orbit, not locale-sensitive case mapping or Unicode17 folding. The same pinned fold domain must govern compiled regex, strings.EqualFold optimizations, prefix/suffix scans and rune canonicalization. Kelvin K/k/U+212A and long-s S/s/U+017F are stable reference folds, but Unicode17-added U+A7CB<->U+0264 must not leak into either reference.

primitive_probes.reason: simple fold is not full multi-character case folding

obligations.semantic_rule: Perl \d, \s, \w and POSIX bracket classes are their pinned ASCII class tables; they do not expand to Unicode category sets. \b and \B use ASCII word membership. With i flag, ASCII class rune sets can gain Unicode simple-fold equivalents such as Kelvin and long-s, but digits do not acquire Unicode17 decimal digits.

3.1.0 optimized case-insensitive prefix/suffix matcher compares a byte slice of len(pattern literal) using strings.EqualFold, then slices the residual using the same literal byte length. Fold-equivalent runes with different UTF8 encoded lengths can fail this optimized path even though the compiled regex would match. Preserve this reference path distinction; label_replace directly uses compiled regexp, not the FastRegexMatcher optimizer.

FastRegexMatcher optimization normalizes indexed strings using norm.NFKD plus unicode.ToLower. Pin BOTH the x/text module v0.21.0 and its selected Unicode15 table under go1.23.4. x/text v0.42.0 selects tables15.0.0.go under !go1.27, but tables17.0.0.go under go1.27. Recompiling the same dependency with owned Go1.27.3 therefore changes normalization data automatically; exact module version alone is insufficient primitive identity. Optimized lookup must preserve the pinned final matcher behavior and not become Unicode normalization of label identity.

primitive_probes.expected: distinct byte strings/labels, not canonically merged
use pinned normalization/final matching, with optimizer context distinctions above

obligations.semantic_rule: Selector regex and label_replace compile whole-value anchored (?s:pattern) expressions; default dot therefore crosses newline in these callers. Inline flags can locally disable s. Captures use leftmost-first RE2 choice, not POSIX longest-submatch selection. Replacement expands $name/${name}/$number, $$ literal dollar; longest alphanumeric name wins, so $1x differs from ${1}x. Unknown/unmatched groups expand empty. Preserve pinned regex capture indices through Unicode UTF8 matching.

Pin UTF8 decode/validation semantics at regex and query-input boundaries: malformed UTF8 in a regex pattern is a compile error; regexp text iteration decodes each malformed byte as RuneError U+FFFD, not Latin1 or byte-wise Unicode characters. PromQL label/query validators may reject malformed encodings before regex execution; keep that layer distinct from the primitive. Own Go1.27.3 has matching utf8.go source bytes to Go1.26.10, but that fact does not prove regexp or Unicode table compatibility.

primitive_probes.expected: apply earlier UTF8 validation; do not bypass validation because regex primitive can decode RuneError

version_changes.description: go1.23.4 / Unicode15.0.0 / grafana-regexp v0.0.0-20240518133315-a468a5bfb3bc / xtext v0.21.0 selected Unicode15; owned Go1.27.3 / Unicode17 is not equivalent.
go1.26.10 / Unicode15.0.0 / grafana-regexp v0.0.0-20250905093917-f7b3be9d1853 / xtext v0.42.0 selected Unicode15; owned Go1.27.3 / Unicode17 is not equivalent.
Go1.23.4 and Go1.26.10 both report Unicode15.0.0, but newer C includes unassigned codepoints and adds exact Cn/LC category names.
Go1.26/1.27 stdlib regex accepts canonicalized/aliased property names, Assigned and ASCII; both pinned Grafana regex parsers do not.
Unicode17 adds eleven script keys, 10615 formerly unassigned codepoints, new fold pairs and category reassignments. Do not use owned Unicode17 tables for either reference.
Prometheus3.13.5 case-insensitive optimized prefix/suffix scans account for unequal UTF8 fold lengths, unlike3.1.0 fixed-byte slicing.
x/text0.42 selects Unicode17 normalization tables when rebuilt under Go1.27; referenceGo1.26 selects Unicode15 despite same x/text module pin.
